checks: During a real 64-MiB cooperative USB import, Save As and Save refuse without changing the active job, publishing the unsaved document or losing text; Cancel leaves the destination unpublished and source byte-identical
After cancellation an actual Save As opens; another Files window cannot start a paste or replace that dialog owner, and exact unsaved text survives
Removing the actual USB source during another active import reports failure and leaves its destination unpublished; the original source image remains byte-identical
scope: Actual virtual USB hardware with a bounded source-read rate; not a throughput benchmark.

resources.scope: Before app launch/transfers, after USB discovery; after cancellation, removed-source failure and closing both apps. Freed USB pages are recorded separately.
